Home/Privacy & this website

Privacy, simply explained.

What this website does with your choices, and what stays in your browser.

The care-note form

The form asks for a care category and a timeframe. It does not request names, contact information, addresses, medical records or other personal details. The choices and generated note stay in page memory. This website does not save them to a database or browser storage, and they are not sent to Gentle Hands.

Copying or downloading a note

Copying places the generated note on your device’s clipboard. Downloading creates a text file on your device. You decide whether to keep or share it. Neither action sends an enquiry or makes a booking.

Search and site features

FAQ search filters the questions already loaded in the page. There are no analytics scripts, advertising trackers or application cookies added by this website. Access to the private preview is managed by the Sites hosting platform, which has its own authentication and service policies.

Fonts and hosting

The website loads Figtree from Google Fonts. Loading external fonts and hosted pages involves normal network requests to those providers. The website does not control their infrastructure or policies.

Before public launch

The business contact details and any policies for future enquiries or bookings have not yet been supplied. This page describes the current website features. It does not set terms for a care service or describe a future patient-record system.
